dedupe_keys.name: 236 bus low voltage distribution network data

description: Bruno Canizes, Fábio Castro, Vitor Silveira and Zita Vale at GECAD and the Polytechnic of Porto publish a low-voltage distribution-network case. It contains 236 buses, 235 underground cables and ninety-six residential customers supplied through a 1,000-kVA, 10-kV/420-V transformer. Cable resistances, reactances and thermal limits accompany demand, EV-demand and photovoltaic-generation profiles for 8,640 fifteen-minute periods. Zenodo supplies an Excel workbook released in August 2023, free under CC BY 4.0. The metadata do not identify the geographic coverage, calendar dates or how the represented customers were selected. These inputs support local power-flow and EV/PV integration simulations, subject to checking units and network conventions in the workbook. No related catalogue resource is explicitly identified. The file was not opened, and the earlier transport-only rejection does not apply to electrical buses.
